title: Toward a Systematic Understanding and Interactive Search of Lyapunov-Style Proofs in Optimization
summary: Lyapunov-style convergence proofs, which establish a nonincreasing sequence to provide a quantitative convergence rate for an algorithm, are popular and often considered desirable in first-order optimization. However, existing approaches to finding such Lyapunov functions rely on hand-designed templates or prior insight on the proof structure, and do not certify that the resulting Lyapunov-style analysis provides the sharpest convergence bound.
